//: SPA fallback. Every unknown path serves index.html so client-side routing works; Vercel never lists a directory.
//cleanUrls: Prevents /some/path/ from resolving to a directory index.

headers.//: Security headers for every document response served by Vercel. The API sets its own, stricter, set — see backend/src/middleware/securityHeaders.js.

CSP for the SPA. 'unsafe-inline' is present for style-src only because Tailwind's runtime and React inline styles require it; script-src has NO unsafe-inline or unsafe-eval, which is what actually blocks injected script. connect-src must list your API origin.
headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://*.onrender.com https://*.supabase.co; frame-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests

headers.//: Two years, all subdomains, preload-eligible. After the first HTTPS response the browser refuses plain HTTP to this host entirely.

headers.value: accelerometer=(), autoplay=(), camera=(), display-capture=(), encrypted-media=(), geolocation=(), gyroscope=(), magnetometer=(), microphone=(), midi=(), payment=(), usb=(), xr-spatial-tracking=()

headers.//: Content-hashed asset filenames are safe to cache forever.
index.html must never be cached, or a deploy will not reach users and a revoked build stays live.
